title: Pronunciation and Vocabulary (Theme 8: Domestic animals)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 English; not yet checked by a Kenyan English teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child listens for the whole sound group (-ft, -ct, -lt, -rd), not only the first letter, and picks the word that has it.

floor.prerequisite: Hears the first sound of a word.
floor.question: Does "belt" start like "bell"?

steps: Say the target sound alone, then in words.
Say two words that differ by one sound; the child picks one.
Find the sound in a short sentence.

board.do: Wait for the child to point.
The child circles the word that was said and says it back.

misconceptions.ask: Buzz or puff at the end?

checks.question: Which word ends with ft: lift, lip, life?
Which word ends with rd: cart, card, car?

skills.key_step: The child says the vowel, then closes the word with every sounded consonant and nothing after.

floor.prerequisite: Says words with one final consonant.
floor.question: Say: hat

steps: Say the word without the last sound.

board.say: Close the word with d and stop. Your turn.

board.do: Wait for the child to say hand.
The child crosses out the silent b in lamb.

misconceptions.ask: Did you add a sound at the end?

listen_for: lamb with a b at the end

checks.question: Say: I drink milk at lunch.
checks.answer: milk and lunch with no extra vowel

checks.question: Say: The lamb is in the camp.
checks.answer: lam(b) silent b, camp with p
